V4-66.04.note: no implementation or test evidence registered
V4-66.04.text: Source snapshots MUST preserve observation date and edition; contradictory or changed source statements require a new disposition.

V4-66.05.note: no implementation or test evidence registered
V4-66.05.text: No model weights, competitor stacks, private datasets, or paid inference were provisioned by this specification task.

C01.text: Fresh setup, explicit consent, capture, drain, recall, restart preserve exact evidence and receipts

C02.text: Same external ID in two scopes remains two independent sources with independent purge boundaries

C03.text: Mutated payload or span digest fails closed in recall, inspect, export, and compilation

C04.text: Legacy null digest is labeled unverified and cannot become verified through fallback

C05.text: Agent text claiming human authorship remains agent-attributed evidence

C07.text: Read/recall on A plus read/evaluate on B cannot disclose B through a query on A

C08.text: Read-only authority cannot obtain raw quotation bytes through any pack or inspection surface

C09.text: Delegating empty purposes from an evaluate-only grant grants no recall authority

C10.text: Delegation cannot remove a parent caveat or extend expiry/depth

C11.text: An authorized identifier never widens a search into a forbidden scope

C12.text: Holding a span suppresses claims, summaries, procedures, caches, and source browsing that depend on it

C13.text: Empty pipeline caused by holds or budget limits cannot trigger raw-source bypass or oversized output

C14.text: Document embedding dispatch without matching consent/reservation never reaches the fake transport

C15.text: Query embedding dispatch is denied at zero budget even with a configured healthy encoder

C16.text: Telemetry export obeys recipient consent and is absent in offline profiles

C17.text: Revocation during inference prevents later plan publication and later delivery permit issuance

C18.text: Expired, replayed, or wrong-recipient dispatch permits cannot send content

C19.text: A made-up checker name plus success remains self-reported and cannot become a verified episode outcome

C20.text: A valid receipt for another task/scope/artifact cannot certify the current task

C21.text: Cancellation immediately before admission leaves no new claim, edge, index row, or receipt

C22.text: Crash between domain application and response yields one committed effect and a replayable receipt

C23.text: Restart reclaims abandoned leases while stale workers remain unable to commit

C24.text: Duplicate operation lookup succeeds under queue saturation without enqueueing duplicate work

C25.text: Privacy work progresses under enrichment saturation without permanent starvation of another scope

C26.text: Unrelated later events do not satisfy readiness for an unfinished captured input

C27.text: A drain reports follow-up work enqueued into an earlier-priority lane and does not claim completion prematurely

C28.text: Writer contention cannot block a foreground request beyond its admitted deadline contract

C29.text: Missing mandatory handler/capability produces durable typed failure, not silent success

C30.text: Unauthorized errors, metadata counts, and lineage handles do not reveal private object existence

C31.text: More than 160 held lexical matches do not hide the next eligible matching claim

C32.text: Adding private alpha-heavy documents cannot reorder an unchanged public alpha/beta result set

C33.text: Dense search works at 4,096, 4,097, 10K, and 100K eligible spans with honest completed/partial coverage

C34.text: Namespaced model names including provider punctuation produce valid stable artifact identities

C35.text: Rebuilding one scope neither strands another scope nor exposes partial staging generations

C36.text: Future revisions and statistics cannot alter a known-at result except current access/deletion suppression

C37.text: Held-out paraphrase queries retrieve supporting evidence without a hard lexical-overlap veto

C38.text: Same-name people and ambiguous pronouns remain distinct or explicitly unresolved

C39.text: Unknown conditions cannot become applicable procedures or unconditional claims

C40.text: Hedged, negated, hypothetical, and quoted retirement mentions do not cause false automatic supersession

C41.text: Genuine supported changes update current-state recall while preserving eligible historical evidence

C42.text: Opaque or incomplete tool sequences remain evidence rather than falsely complete reusable procedures

C43.text: Changed environment/tool schemas block stale procedure applicability and request verification

C44.text: A generated lesson cannot promote itself or grant execution permission

C45.text: Verified failed execution remains negative evidence despite a helpfulness vote or agent success claim

C46.text: Generated quote text with invalid locators is rejected even when its output schema is valid

C47.text: Unsupported summary propositions stay out of factual packs and cannot corroborate later summaries

C48.text: A derivative combining two audiences is unavailable to a recipient denied either required parent

C49.text: Correcting or holding a parent immediately invalidates cached generated overviews

C50.text: Reflection stops at its call/token/deadline limit and cannot invoke arbitrary host tools

C51.text: L0/L1/L2 expansion preserves caller binding and exact final byte/token limits

C52.text: Screening one required conflict/context member omits the whole group, not a misleading remainder

C53.text: Fuzzy cache does not reuse current-state, negated, or exact-identifier answers unsafely

C54.text: Cache hits after revoke/erase cannot bypass current authorization or suppression

C55.text: A 513-child purge retains continuation and erases all children before terminal success

C56.text: A 50K-descendant closure survives crashes and retries with no lost frontier or sibling-scope deletion

C57.text: Mixed-ancestry derivatives are withheld until rebuilt solely from surviving authorized evidence

C58.text: Embedding/synthesis completion after parent purge cannot republish erased information

C59.text: Restoring an old backup reconciles erasure state or stays explicitly unproven/locked for serving

C60.text: Missing keys and interrupted key creation cannot silently regenerate keys or expose plaintext

C61.text: Concurrent key rotation and hydration yield exact bytes or typed denial, never wrong plaintext

C62.text: Killing every migration phase resumes or rolls back without falsely advancing schema version

C63.text: Changed historical migration checksum blocks unsafe mutation with a diagnostic

C64.text: Multiple SQLite processes preserve idempotency, migration exclusion, and bounded contention

C65.text: PostgreSQL and SQLite produce equivalent authority/lifecycle results from identical operation streams

C66.text: Service failover and replica lag cannot acknowledge lost privacy changes or stale authorization

C67.text: File projection edit creates a reviewed attributed revision; path escapes and active HTML are rejected

C68.text: Imported bundle signature never grants local authority; stale erased content cannot resurrect

C69.text: Connector permission loss suppresses local derivatives and survives interrupted reconciliation

C70.text: Provider import without original sources preserves imported-assertion status and reports provenance loss
